identitySignals: The only 'Learning Without Limits' I found in Oakland is an elementary school (Pre-K to 5th grade) in Oakland Unified School District itself, listed on DonorsChoose and in Oakland Fund for Children and Youth grant lists under Oakland Leaf Foundation.

A school inside the district would not normally sign a Memorandum of Understanding with OUSD as an outside workplace training partner. The vendor may be a different organization with the same name, and I found no registry entry (ProPublica, California Secretary of State or SAM.gov) for one.
research.notes: Could not identify a distinct legal entity named 'Learning Without Limits' in Oakland. The only match was an OUSD elementary school, which is probably not the contracting vendor. No website, contact details or registry IDs were confirmed, so nothing is published. A reviewer should check the full MOU text to see who the counterparty is.
